DS.logoRule: Keep verified external brand asset bytes and proportions; no crop, recolour, frame or invented substitute. Named text fallback when unavailable.

invariants.calculation: Preserve current v1.7 criteria, Supply-relative, brand overrides and saved context semantics. No change to Demand/Supply formulas, national cutoffs, Tier, possiblePatterns, eligibility or rank from performance changes.
invariants.geography: Preserve source geometry, crosswalk, original source metric area denominators and point coordinates. View-only polygon matches never write administrative assignment or alter aggregate supply.
invariants.states: Observed zero, missing, suppressed, not-applicable, invalid and review states remain distinct.
invariants.view: One existing Leaflet instance. Ordinary sync does not refit. Pan/zoom/popup/external search remain personal actions with no team event or source/criteria mutation.
invariants.persistence: Keep source snapshot caches separate from local overlays; preserve other industry/brand/scope contexts and drafts.
invariants.claimLimit: Proxy screening and contextual source listings, not measured visits/sales/borrowing, current branch operations, legal-boundary certification or parcel feasibility.

runtimePlan.viewport: RAF-coalesce moveend/zoomend into point/visible-count refresh; do not rebuild evaluator, rank maps, country/district choropleths or computed styles for a view-only event.
runtimePlan.fullSync: Run on meaningful context/criteria/route/source/theme changes using a single owning integration point; cache verified token values within one sync without changing analytical HEX.
runtimePlan.markers: Reconcile canonical point ID/context. Retain an open in-scope popup anchor across viewport-only pan/zoom, resize and autopan even if temporarily offscreen. Visible counts exclude an offscreen retained anchor. Closing, filters, source polygon and context exclusions prune it correctly; source totals unchanged.
runtimePlan.staleGuards: Capture context and route ticket before await; cancel old event navigation or focus when route/context/newer request changes.

implementationAPI.loadOrder: after brand/icon modules; popup CSS after workspace styles

runtimePlan.workerServer: Not implied by RAF scheduling. Production workers/spatial APIs and physical-device performance validation remain separate work.

navigationHover.outline: exact source polygon; fill=false; no analytical value encoding
navigationHover.pointerTargets: Unfilled source-boundary hit paths above analytical fills. .workspace-map-panel .leaflet-overlay-pane svg path.workspace-navigation-hit {pointer-events:all;cursor:pointer} must outrank Leaflet SVG path rules; outlines use pointer-events:none. Load CSS after Leaflet/workspace CSS.

implementationAPI.target: Exact source Polygon/MultiPolygon feature; level province|district|location. Caller owns hierarchy lookup and click/keyboard navigation.

navigationHover.activeToken: --yl-map-active; exact native observed dark #65B6DB and light #347DA8. UI hover is not a demand value or choropleth replacement.
navigationHover.statePolicy: Clear on navigation/context changes; same-target motion reuses outline; late mouseout cannot clear a newer target. No source write, team event, centroid or bounding-box substitute.

runtimePlan.preparedEvaluation: Prepare deterministic criteria-only metric IDs/groups/cutoffs for one uncached evaluation and reuse Supply thresholds inside weighted ranking; discard preparation before returning. No mutable-criteria preparation survives a draft/context.
runtimePlan.resize: ResizeObserver measures host clientHeight and sets --workspace-popup-max-height=max(100,height-64)px; invalidateSize({pan:true,animate:false}) preserves geographic centre, then updates an open popup without refitting.

coldBranchForm.routePolicy: Existing #poi/{id}: show loading until selected inventory is ready, then render only the requested real record. Absent ready record and source failure remain status states. Only explicit #poi/new creates an empty new form.
coldBranchForm.draftPolicy: Capture only current rendered route/context; restore only matching record ID. Preserve original expected revision for save-conflict detection, user values, area, focus and cursor; never restore file inputs. New/other-record snapshots cannot overwrite the loaded source branch.
